# Socialsect
> Patient acquisition systems for private medical practices (US & UK)

## Core pages
- [Home](https://gosocialsect.com/): Socialsect homepage - patient acquisition for private medical practices
- [Services](https://gosocialsect.com/services): Practice websites, SEO, Meta ads, Google ads, brand identity
- [How We Work](https://gosocialsect.com/how-we-work): Our process and methodology
- [Results](https://gosocialsect.com/results): Case studies and client outcomes
- [About](https://gosocialsect.com/about): About Socialsect

## Services
- [Practice Websites](https://gosocialsect.com/services/build/websites): Medical practice website design and development
- [SEO](https://gosocialsect.com/services/grow/seo): Search engine optimization for medical practices
- [Meta Ads](https://gosocialsect.com/services/grow/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram advertising
- [Google Ads](https://gosocialsect.com/services/grow/google-ads): Google search advertising
- [Brand Identity](https://gosocialsect.com/services/brand/identity): Brand strategy and visual identity
- [Content Library](https://gosocialsect.com/services/brand/content-library): Marketing content creation
